issue.symptom: POST /api/checkout returns HTTP 500 for orders of 30 or more units of one item; smaller orders work.

observations.text: Large checkout (qty 30) returns 500, small (qty 5) succeeds. Logs show IndexError in bulk_rate: BULK_TIERS[qty//10] out of range for qty 30.
evidence: logs storefront-54b87754b-8w94s IndexError list index out of range at pricing.py:43

hypotheses.text: bulk_rate uses BULK_TIERS[qty//10] with only 3 entries (indices 0,1,2). For qty>=30, index 3+ out of range. Should cap at last tier per docs: 20+ units = 10%.

agent_conclusion.root_cause: Code bug in storefront/pricing.py bulk_rate(): BULK_TIERS has 3 entries (0%,5%,10%) but indexing was BULK_TIERS[qty//10] without capping. For qty 30, index 3 out of range -> IndexError -> 500. Per docs/pricing.md, 20+ units should be 10%.
agent_conclusion.summary: Fixed bulk_rate to cap index at len(BULK_TIERS)-1, added regression test for qty 30 and 500, built and deployed new image kubetrace/storefront:20261016-153509-68ae37-0b0acd84-b1. Verified checkout for 30 mugs now returns 200 with correct totals (360 gross, 36 discount, 349.92 total) and 500 qty also succeeds; rollout complete with 2 ready pods.
evidence: logs IndexError list index out of range pricing.py:43

+from decimal import Decimal
+from storefront.pricing import PricingConfig, quote
+
+CFG = PricingConfig(currency="USD", tax_rate=Decimal("0.08"), shipping_flat=Decimal("6.00"),
+                    free_shipping_threshold=Decimal("75"))
+
+def test_bulk_30_mugs_ten_percent():
+    # 30 * 12.00 = 360.00 gross, 10% bulk = 36.00, after_bulk 324, free shipping, tax 25.92, total 349.92
+    q = quote([{"sku": "MUG-01", "qty": 30}], None, CFG)
+    assert q["bulk_discount"] == "36.00"
+    assert q["shipping"] == "0.00"
+    assert q["total"] == "349.92"
+
+def test_bulk_500_max_qty():
+    q = quote([{"sku": "MUG-01", "qty": 500}], None, CFG)
+    # 500*12=6000 gross, 10% =600 discount
+    assert q["bulk_discount"] == "600.00"
